name: Kuroya Sou
source:
The director of the Kuroya Clinic. As the only medical facility in the settlement, the clinic is a lifeline for the people who live there. He’s done a comprehensive study of medicine and examines his patients using both internal and external medicine. 

He’s a splendid, friendly doctor who treats his patients warmly; the villagers all trust him. 

His family consists of [url=/c11258]Yuzuru[/url], who married his daughter, and [url=/c11247]Naori[/url], his grandson. He treats his nurse [url=/c6402]Nanako[/url] like family as well, occasionally touching her butt to "check her condition." Though it bothers Nanako, she’s so used to it that she treats it as a minor annoyance. 

"If only you would marry into the family, Nanako-kun... (To me.)"

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=139]MangaGamer[/url]]
